title: PlantVirusAnalysisPlatform: an offline-deployable, end-to-end plant virus analysis platform for Windows
description:
PlantVirusAnalysisPlatform is a Windows-native platform that runs a 15-stage plant virus analysis pipeline behind a local web interface, a CLI and an MCP server: host depletion, dual-engine known-virus identification and quantification (salmon / minibwa), de novo assembly, consensus calling, ORF annotation, phylogenetics, recombination screening, primer design and report generation. It ships with assembled reference libraries, runs fully offline, and is benchmarked against the VIROMOCK and Bari inter-laboratory panels.

This record archives the software release. Reference libraries and benchmark inputs are obtained from their upstream sources; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and docs/paper/benchmark/README.
